name: werkmeister-mcp
description: The werkmeister MCP server: every tool, over stdio and authenticated HTTP, including the MCP App UI tools and the App pages they serve. Bundled into the CLI.

scripts.build: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && pnpm run build:ui
scripts.build:ui: cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build && cross-env INPUT=mcp-list.html vite build
